description: This file contains unit tests for the HostEnvSanitizer utility in the OpenClaw project, verifying environment sanitization functions such as overlaying overrides, handling shell wrappers, and rejecting invalid keys.

classes.name: HostEnvSanitizerTests
classes.description: A collection of unit tests for HostEnvSanitizer utility functions.

methods.name: sanitize blocks shell trace variables
methods.description: Tests that certain environment variables related to shell tracing are cleared when sanitized.

methods.name: sanitize shell wrapper allows only explicit override keys
methods.description: Verifies that only specified environment variables are preserved when using a shell wrapper.

methods.name: sanitize non shell wrapper keeps regular overrides
methods.description: Checks that overrides are retained properly when not using a shell wrapper.

methods.name: inspect overrides rejects blocked and invalid keys
methods.description: Ensures that invalid or blocked environment variable keys are correctly identified during inspection.

methods.name: sanitize accepts Windows-style override key names
methods.description: Tests that Windows-style environment variable keys are accepted and preserved.
